app_summary: A social network with unidirectional follow relationships, implemented with loosely-coupled microservices, communicating with each other via Thrift RPCs. Supported Operations: Create text post (optional media: image, video, shortened URL, user tag), Read post, Read entire user timeline, Receive recommendations on which users to follow, Search database for user or post, Register/Login using user credentials, Follow/Unfollow user
RCA_gt: The `user-service` deployment is deleted and reapplied with `nodeSelector.kubernetes.io/hostname: extra-node`. Because `extra-node` does not exist, replacement user-service pods cannot be scheduled.
_source_comment: Ground truth source: AIOpsLab/aiopslab/orchestrator/problems/assign_non_existent_node/assign_non_existent_node_social_net.py (faulty_service and injector call); AIOpsLab/aiopslab/generators/fault/inject_virtual.py (nodeSelector value and deployment replacement); AIOpsLab/aiopslab/orchestrator/problems/registry.py (problem ID).
